description: Gather facts from ZFS pool properties.

parameters.name: parsable
parameters.description: Specifies if property values should be displayed in machine friendly format. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: properties
parameters.description: Specifies which dataset properties should be queried in comma-separated format. For more information about dataset properties, check zpool(1M) man page. Default: "all"

examples:
- name: Gather facts about ZFS pool rpool
  community.general.zpool_facts: pool=rpool

- name: Gather space usage about all imported ZFS pools
  community.general.zpool_facts: properties='free,size'

- name: Print gathered information
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: 'ZFS pool {{ item.name }} has {{ item.free }} free space out of {{ item.size }}.'
  with_items: '{{ ansible_zfs_pools }}'

return_values.name: ansible_zfs_pools
return_values.description: ZFS pool facts.
